title: 3D Histogram with Categories and Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements a 3D histogram visualization with category management and full undo/redo support. Load the 'DragonAttenuation.glb' model using GLTFLoader and place it as a decorative element on a pedestal to the right side of the histogram.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (8, 6, 10) looking at the origin.
- Add OrbitControls for camera manipulation.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 0.8.
- Create a ground plane (20x20, dark gray #333333) at y=0.
- Load DragonAttenuation.glb using GLTFLoader from '../../../assets/shared/DragonAttenuation.glb'. Scale it to fit roughly 2 units tall and place it at position (6, 0, -3) on a small pedestal (cylinder, radius 1, height 0.3, color #666666).

HISTOGRAM BARS:
- Start with 5 categories: ['Alpha', 'Beta', 'Gamma', 'Delta', 'Epsilon']
- Initial values: [4, 7, 3, 9, 5]
- Each bar is a BoxGeometry with width=0.8, depth=0.8, height=value (scaled so value 1 = 0.5 units height).
- Bar colors by index: [#FF6B6B, #4ECDC4, #45B7D1, #96CEB4, #FFEAA7]
- Bars are positioned along the X axis with spacing 1.5 units apart, centered around x=0.
- Each bar sits on the ground plane with its base at y=0.
- Add 3D text labels below each bar showing the category name (use simple sprite text or canvas-based text sprites).
- Add value labels on top of each bar showing the numeric value.

UI ELEMENTS (DOM overlay):
- A top toolbar div with:
  - 'Add Category' button (id='btn-add') - adds a new category with name 'Cat_N' and random value 1-10
  - 'Remove Last' button (id='btn-remove') - removes the last category
  - 'Undo' button (id='btn-undo') - undoes the last action
  - 'Redo' button (id='btn-redo') - redoes the last undone action
  - 'Randomize' button (id='btn-randomize') - sets all bar values to new random integers 1-10
  - 'Sort Asc' button (id='btn-sort-asc') - sorts bars by value ascending
  - 'Sort Desc' button (id='btn-sort-desc') - sorts bars by value descending
- A info panel (id='info-panel') showing: total categories count, sum of all values, average value (2 decimal places), and the current history stack size.
- Style buttons with padding 8px 16px, border-radius 4px, background #4A90D9, color white.

INTERACTION - BAR CLICKING:
- Implement raycasting so clicking on a bar selects it (highlight with emissive color #FFFF00).
- When a bar is selected, show an input field (id='value-input') and 'Set Value' button (id='btn-set-value') to change its value (1-10 range, clamp if outside).
- Only one bar can be selected at a time. Clicking empty space deselects.

KEYBOARD:
- Ctrl+Z triggers Undo
- Ctrl+Y triggers Redo
- Delete key removes the selected bar (if any)

UNDO/REDO SYSTEM:
- Maintain a history stack of states. Each state is a snapshot of {categories: [...], values: [...]}.
- Maximum history depth: 20 entries.
- Every action (add, remove, randomize, sort, set value, delete) pushes a new state.
- Undo restores the previous state; Redo restores the next state.
- When a new action is performed after undo, discard the redo future.
- Disable undo button when at the beginning of history, disable redo when at the end.

ANIMATION:
- When bar values change, animate the bar heights smoothly over 500ms using lerp.
- The dragon model should slowly rotate on its pedestal (0.5 rad/s around Y axis).

STATE MANAGEMENT - window.__3D_STATE__ must expose:
- categories: array of category name strings
- values: array of numeric values
- barCount: number of bars currently displayed
- selectedBarIndex: index of selected bar or -1 if none
- historyIndex: current position in history stack (0-based)
- historyLength: total number of states in history
- canUndo: boolean
- canRedo: boolean
- sumValues: sum of all current values
- avgValue: average of current values (2 decimal places as number)
- dragonLoaded: boolean, true once the GLB model is loaded
- sortOrder: 'none' | 'asc' | 'desc' reflecting last sort applied
- lastAction: string describing last action performed ('init', 'add', 'remove', 'undo', 'redo', 'randomize', 'sort_asc', 'sort_desc', 'set_value', 'delete')

Update window.__3D_STATE__ on every change synchronously before the next frame.
physics_constraints: Bar heights must be non-negative and correspond to values 1-10 (height = value * 0.5). Bars must not overlap. Undo/redo must perfectly restore previous states. All numeric values must be valid (no NaN/Infinity). History stack must not exceed 20 entries.
